overview_description.description:
Startups Galaxy is martech platform focusing on growth through top Experts matched through the startup profile.  We match 2 or more experts depending on the milestones selected for each startup. We use our data to select the best, reducing time founders spend searching, hiring and wasting costs and time on freelancers, consultants or hires.

Current Products:

1 - Experts Matchmaking
- SEO Experts
- Data Experts
- Analytics Experts
- Social Media Experts
- Performance Ads Experts
- Growth Marketing Experts
- Content Experts
- Conversion Experts

2- Startup Projects (Beta Launching July 2021)


3- Resources Hub (PDFs, Ebooks, Case Studies)


4- Deals (Up to $1 million on discounts on tools)
